title: UTMB World Series 2026 Season Calendar Revealed
claims: The UTMB World Series 2026 circuit lists 64 events across five continents; nine new events join in 2026, with four Majors unchanged.

The UTMB World Series 2026 announcement names its new events in Europe, Asia and North America and its four Majors (Australia, Val d'Aran, Kodiak, Chiang Mai); Ultra-Trail Cape Town is not named in the announcement.

UTMB.world athlete indexes carry UTCT results, but index inclusion does not by itself make UTCT a UTMB World Series member; the official UTCT site remains independently branded under the RMB title sponsorship.

claimVerification.note: 新闻稿：In 2026, 64 events ... across all five continents；9 new events；four Majors retain the same format and races。
新增事件清单（葡萄牙/德国/罗马尼亚/拉脱维亚/台湾/中国/阿曼/美国/加拿大）与四大 Majors 中均无 Cape Town；南非赛事未出现在公告文本里。
UTMB.world 个人成绩页收录 UTCT 记录为索引收录；是否系列成员应以官方品牌与公告为准。未检索到 UTMB 集团收购 UTCT 的官方公告；本条为口径边界说明，不写成成员资格结论。
